about: Sleep staging (App. C.2): a five-class linear probe per 30 s epoch, unweighted loss, C chosen per fold from 0.001 to 100 on validation Cohen's kappa.
_doc: Sleep staging: five-class per-epoch linear probe (Appendix C.2). The label mode is named here rather than on every command line, because staging is the experiment, not a dataset setting. Unweighted loss, and C chosen per fold from the grid below on the validation fold's Cohen's kappa, as the paper says (C.2: the grid 1e-3 to 1e2, Cohen's kappa as selection criterion); selection_metric cohen_kappa picks the seed by the same criterion. The event and diagnosis probes keep C = 1. This block sets the probe's --tune-c, --class-weight and --selection-metric, so the probe refuses a different value for them.
